result.reason: The added Licensor indemnity includes the preferred claim categories, but the operative language does not reach the playbook position. It omits standard notice, defense-control, and cooperation procedures; leaves Licensee’s indemnity far broader than Customer-provided content and breach of law; and retains Article XIII’s express disclaimer of Licensor liability for infringement claims and its one-half-fees cap, which materially undermines the new indemnity and falls below the 3× annual-fees fallback super-cap. The amendment is targeted and does not disturb unrelated terms, but the internal conflicts and retained drafting defects prevent professional, effective implementation.
